page.layout: One printed page, a title page, centred lines with an engraving below. No margin text. Handwriting at top, right and bottom left is not printed and is left out.
page.notes: The engraving shows a woodcut of a wooded landscape in an oval frame; not transcribed. Handwritten annotations (1899. 2483; "8 Pol. I 1002"; "Joh. Conrad Caußenig D.") and a manuscript mark are not printed and are omitted. The "ṔVBLICIS" initial P is a swash capital; the letter is read as P with a decorative stroke. Printed "Dantiscano" line-break hyphen kept as printed.
